summary: Iter149 Dark Mode comprehensive verification + 54-feature regression smoke. DARK MODE: VERIFIED PASS across all 6 requested public/auth pages (/, /login, /register, /pricing, /blog, /faq) AND /select-account post-login. Both html.dark and body.dark-mode classes applied simultaneously by ThemeProvider; body background is rgb(11,18,32) #0b1220 on every page; primary headings render in rgb(255,255,255) or rgb(241,245,249). Login page specifically verified: form labels (اسم المستخدم / كلمة المرور) render in rgb(249,250,251) ✓ (near-white as required), inputs have dark backgrounds rgb(31,41,55) ✓ with light text rgb(249,250,251) ✓, 'تذكرني' label rgb(226,232,240) light grey ✓, logo halo box-shadow includes indigo tint rgba(99,102,241,0.25) ✓. Pricing screenshot confirms 4 dark cards (المؤسسة/المحترف/الأساسية/المجتمع) with white bold prices ($70/$40/$12/$0), EGP/USD toggle visible. /select-account also dark-mode compliant. REGRESSIONS — Light Mode: localStorage.removeItem('darkMode')+reload removes html.dark cleanly, body bg returns to rgb(255,255,255), no dark style leak. Theme toggle button [data-testid='theme-toggle'] click flips light→dark, sets localStorage darkMode='true' and applies html.dark class within 400ms. Backend smoke: GET /api/blog/posts=200, POST /api/auth/login (testcompany2/Company123!)=200 returns access_token+user payload, POST /api/mobile/auth/register=201 with access_token (Feature #55 mobile auth not regressed by CSS changes). Login as testcompany2 successfully redirects to /select-account (multi-account picker) — expected behavior for users with multiple personas (4 compound_admin + 1 company_admin entries).
critical_code_review_comments: Console reports (report-only) repeatedly logging CSP frame-ancestors violations for https://www.google.com/ — this comes from an embedded preview iframe (Emergent overlay), not our app. Safe to ignore but worth muting in production CSP-report endpoint to reduce noise.

Some 403/400 console errors flagged appear on every page load — likely related to optional analytics endpoints or auth-protected resources hit while unauthenticated. Not blocking but worth tracing in next iter.
